earnings.title: My Earnings
earnings.info_dialog_body:
Doondo records the pay each employer agreed to when you were hired. The total here is the value of every contract you've won — it does NOT include money actually moved to your bank yet.

Direct bank payouts arrive in a future update. Until then, payment happens between you and the employer the way you agreed (cash, UPI, etc.). If an employer doesn't pay, message Doondo Support.

earnings.empty_message: Every job you're hired for shows up here with the pay the employer agreed to. Direct bank payouts arrive in a future update.
earnings.log_modal_body: Worked outside Doondo and got paid in cash? Add it here to keep your earnings record complete — useful for loans, tax, and remittance planning. Stays private to you.

payslip.title: Your Payslip Explained
payslip.tagline: PF, ESI and tax — what those deductions really mean.
payslip.intro: Starting your first formal job? Your payslip will show some money taken out. Most of it actually helps you — here's how.
payslip.pf_what: {{pct}}% of your basic pay goes into a savings fund. Your employer adds the same amount on top — free money for you.
payslip.pf_get: It is your money. You get all of it back with interest (around 8% a year) when you change jobs or retire.
payslip.pf_note: PF is not a loss — it is savings you build without thinking about it.
payslip.esi_what: Just {{pct}}% of your wages buys health cover for you and your family — if you earn up to ₹{{ceiling}} a month.
payslip.esi_get: It pays for hospital treatment, and gives you money during sickness, injury, or maternity leave.
payslip.tax_free: Under the new tax system, yearly income up to ₹{{lakh}} lakh is completely tax-free.
payslip.tax_most: Most workers on Doondo earn below this — so they pay zero income tax.
payslip.tax_slabs_intro: Earn more than that? Tax applies in steps:
payslip.payslip_note: The ₹{{pf}} PF is still yours, saved for later — so your real value this month is ₹{{total}}.
payslip.footer: Rates shown for the {{fy}} financial year. Government rates can change with each year's Budget.
payslip.pf_claim_1: You have a UAN — a 12-digit number that stays with you across every job. Ask your employer for it.
payslip.pf_claim_2: Activate your UAN and check your balance on the UMANG app or the EPFO website. Link your Aadhaar, PAN and bank account.
payslip.pf_claim_3: Withdraw online — no employer signature needed for most claims. Take it all after you retire or after 2 months without a job, or take a part for medical, housing, or education needs.
payslip.pf_claim_4: Online claims usually reach your bank in about 3–5 working days.
payslip.esi_claim_1: You get an ESI Pehchan card — your health ID. It covers you and your family.
payslip.esi_claim_2: For treatment, go to any ESI hospital or dispensary and show your Pehchan card with an ID. Care is free.
payslip.esi_claim_3: If a doctor signs you off sick, you can claim sickness benefit — about 70% of your wage — through your employer’s ESI office.
payslip.claim_note: Government portals and steps can change — these are the official sites.
